page.title: Try Ku online
page.shortcuts: ⌘ / Ctrl + Enter to run · ⇧ + ⌘ / Ctrl + Enter to check
page.local: Drafts are saved on this device. Share links contain source: keep secrets out.
page.modulesHelp: Up to 16 files and 256 KiB total, read only during this run. Files are never uploaded. Filenames accept ASCII letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, and dots.
page.limits: Source 64 KiB · Output 64 KiB · Execution deadline about 5 s · WASM memory limit 128 MiB
page.unsupported: The browser preview does not support native network listeners, databases, processes, arbitrary disk access, or the native async scheduler. See actual engine details for its capabilities.
page.noscript: Running online requires JavaScript. You can still read the example or install Ku locally.
page.empty: Real run and check results will appear here.
page.waiting: Engine identity is loaded when you first run or check.
page.description: Edit, check, and run the real Ku interpreter in your browser. A static playground that keeps your source on your device.
page.editorFailure: Editor could not load. Your source is safe.

status.unsupported_in_browser: This capability is unavailable in the browser
status.initializationTimeout: Engine loading timed out. Run or check to retry.
status.initialization_error: Engine could not load or its version did not match. Your draft is safe. Run or check to retry; reload if an older page is open.
status.wasm_trap: The engine stopped unexpectedly (WASM trap). Run again for a fresh instance.
status.protocol_error: Invalid engine response. Run again to retry.
status.stale: Results belong to an earlier source snapshot.
status.replace: Replace your current code and virtual files? Unsaved edits will be lost.
status.shareLoad: This link contains Ku source. Load it into the editor? It will not run automatically.
status.shared: Share link copied. It contains your source and virtual modules; anyone with the link can read them.
status.shareFallback: Select and copy the share link below. It contains your source and virtual modules.
status.clipboard: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the source directly.
status.storage: Draft storage is unavailable. You can keep editing and download your code.
status.invalidShare: Invalid or oversized share link; your current draft was kept.
status.shareLimit: The share payload is larger than 64 KiB. Download your source instead.
status.source_limit: Source is limited to 64 KiB UTF-8.
status.file_limit: Virtual modules are limited to 16 files and 256 KiB total.
status.file_path: Use unique relative .ku paths with ASCII letters, digits, _, -, and dots, without traversal; main.ku is reserved.
status.hidden: Stopped because this page became hidden.
status.imported: Virtual modules loaded as read-only files.
status.choose: Choose a diagnostic to jump to its source.
status.failure: Operation failed. Your source was kept.
